# Spin The Wheels Online

> Free, instant, privacy-first random wheel picker, wheel of names, decision spinner, and raffle generator powered by client-side Web Cryptography (`crypto.getRandomValues()`). Zero signup, zero tracking of wheel lists, up to 500 entries, custom per-slice weighting (1x–20x), elimination draws, ISO/IEC 18004 QR code sharing, and responsive iframe embedding.

## Core Architecture & Features
- **Cryptographic Randomness Engine**: Uses `window.crypto.getRandomValues()` with rejection sampling (`maxValid` ceiling modulo elimination) for unbiased floating-point angles — never naive `Math.random()`.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All wheel entries, spin history CSV exports, and custom themes run in-browser with per-route `localStorage` persistence; no entry lists are uploaded to servers.
- **Weighted Probabilities & Elimination**: Per-slice weight controls (`1x` to `20x`), automatic *Remove Winner After Spin* mode for multi-winner draws, and configurable 2s–20s physics deceleration with mechanical tick & drum audio.
- **Sharing & Embeds**: Stateless `?w=` share URLs, built-in ISO/IEC 18004 QR generator, and clean `?embed=1` iframe snippets for Notion, WordPress, Twitch, and classroom portals.
